title: 🔒 Samsung Hardens One UI 8: Stronger Protection for Your AI and Quantum-Resistant Wi-Fi!
body: 🔒 Samsung Hardens One UI 8: Stronger Protection for Your AI and Quantum-Resistant Wi-Fi!

Samsung has announced a major security upgrade for Galaxy phones running One UI 8, to protect user data and the on-device AI tools that hold sensitive information such as your preferences and daily routine. The upgrade covers protection inside the device itself, and protection as data moves between your devices, so it never reaches prying hands.

The new protection relies on Knox's enhanced encryption technology, which locks down sensitive data inside the device, along with an improved Secure Wi-Fi service to resist future hacking attempts based on quantum computing — ultra-powerful computers that could one day break today's encryption. With this, Samsung is preparing for threats that have not arrived yet, not just current ones.

The upgrade comes at a time when AI tools on phones know more about you than ever: your habits, appointments, messages and photos. Protecting that data on the device itself, instead of sending it to distant servers, has become a priority for companies, and Samsung wants to lead its rivals on this point in particular.
Simply put: your phone knows a lot about you, and now it protects what it knows with a stronger lock — do you trust that your data is safe on your phone?
